1.1 Discuss. How many languages can you speak? How many languages do you think there are in the world?

Muhokama qiling. Nechta tilda gapira olasiz? Sizningcha, dunyoda nechta til bor?

KALIT SOʻZLAR

an alphabet alifbo — tilning barcha harflari

a consonant undosh — b, k yoki t kabi harf

a vowel unli — a, e yoki o kabi harf

a volume jild — bir toʻplamdagi bitta kitob

Five Numbers About Languages

There are more than 7,000 living languages in the world. Here are five numbers from the strangest corners of that list.

840 This is the number of living languages in Papua New Guinea — more than in any other country on Earth. The country has only about ten million people, so that is roughly one language for every twelve thousand people. Why so many? The mountains and valleys are steep and difficult to cross, so for a very long time small groups of people lived close together but almost never met. Indonesia is second, with 711.

12 Rotokas has the shortest alphabet in the world: twelve letters. It comes from Papua New Guinea too, which is not a surprise. Twelve letters sounds impossible, but children learn to read Rotokas faster than English children learn to read English.

74 Khmer, the language of Cambodia, has the longest alphabet in the world — 33 consonants, 23 vowels and 12 more vowels that stand alone. Learning to write it takes years. Learning to say it does not: children speak Khmer perfectly at four, like children everywhere.

600,000 The Oxford English Dictionary contains about six hundred thousand words. It fills twenty volumes and it is far too heavy for one person to carry. Nobody has ever read it, and nobody needs to: most adults use about twenty thousand words in their own language.

900,000,000 More than nine hundred million people speak Mandarin Chinese as a first language. That is more than any other language in the world. English is only about half that number — but if you count people who learned English at school, English wins easily.

Grammar · superlative adjectives

TUSHUNTIRISH — ORTTIRMA DARAJA

Qiyosiy daraja ikki narsani solishtiradi. Orttirma daraja hammasining ichidan bittasini ajratib oladi — va unga deyarli doim the kerak.

A Qisqa sifatlar — -est qoʻshiladi. small → the smallest · hard → the hardest · long → the longest

B -e bilan yoki bitta unli + bitta undosh bilan tugasa. nice → the nicest · big → the biggest · hot → the hottest

C -y bilan tugasa. easy → the easiest · heavy → the heaviest · pretty → the prettiest · dry → the driest

D Uzun sifatlar — the most ishlatiladi. expensive → the most expensive · difficult → the most difficult · popular → the most popular

E Qoidasizlari. good → the best · bad → the worst · far → the furthest

Soʻz tartibi: the most + sifat + ot. the most practical laptop deng, hech qachon the laptop most practical emas.

DIQQAT — KOʻP UCHRAYDIGAN XATOLAR

Besh narsa notoʻgʻri ketadi, oxirgi ikkitasi esa B1 darajagacha ham saqlanib qoladi:

1 Ikkilangan harf. ✗ bigest → ✓ biggest · ✗ cheappest → ✓ cheapest

2 Qisqa sifat bilan most. ✗ Basque is the most hard language. → ✓ Basque is the hardest language.

3 Orttirma daraja oʻrnida qiyosiy daraja. ✗ This is the cheaper dictionary in the shop. → ✓ the cheapest dictionary in the shop · ✗ He's the more intelligent person I know. → ✓ the most intelligent person I know

4 most bilan soʻz tartibi. ✗ This is the laptop most practical for travelling. → ✓ the most practical laptop for travelling

5 most oʻrnida more. ✗ I like more my smartphone. → ✓ I like my smartphone (the) most.

THREE QUESTIONS PEOPLE ALWAYS ASK

What is (1 beautiful) language in the world? There is no answer — everybody says their own, or the first one they learned. What is (2 difficult) language? That depends on your first language: Japanese is very hard for an English speaker and much easier for a Korean one. And what is (3 useful) language to speak? Professor Hunter has (4 good) answer: the language of the country where you live. If you want (5 popular) language in the world, learn Mandarin.

SIX PEOPLE, ONE DISCUSSION BOARD

GENJI I hate it when people look at their phone while they're talking to you. If you're talking to somebody, they should look at you, not at their phone. It's the worst thing you can do.

MEEPE Yes, I agree. I've also got a friend like that. You're talking to him and he starts scrolling on his phone. It's so annoying.

MADMAX Yes, you're right, it's really rude. Some people post photos on social media in the middle of a conversation as well. I hate that.

ADAMB Yes, my sister does that too. We're having dinner and she starts sending texts to all her friends. I text my friends a lot too, but I try to put my phone down during dinner.

LARS2 Sometimes that's annoying, but I can also understand why people do it. Sometimes I want to send an important text before I forget about it.

RAINBOWS I don't agree with you, Genji. I don't mind when my friends are on their phones. Messaging is useful if you want to meet a friend. Also, my friends send really funny texts.

NIGORA The thing I hate most is loud phone calls on the bus. It's a small space and everybody has to listen. Last week a man behind me talked about his brother's divorce for twenty minutes. It's the worst way to start a morning. Also, people always talk louder on the phone than they do to a real person. Why?
